summary:
輝瑞EPS大幅超預期16.18%，成本撙節與核心藥品支撐獲利。
• EPS 0.66美元，大幅超越預期0.57美元，正向驚喜16.18%
• 營收175.6億美元，反映較大基期規模
• 成本撙節計畫成效推升獲利表現
• 腫瘤學與核心藥品組合提供穩定營收基礎
ai_view:
訊號正向：16.18%的EPS大幅超標，主要由成本撙節計畫與核心藥品獲利貢獻，顯示去新冠化壓力下管理層獲利防禦執行良好。短期超標支撐情緒，但缺乏營收年增資料使成長趨勢判讀保守，市場關注全年指引能否上修。中期關鍵在腫瘤學整合與管線兌現。追蹤指標：非新冠營收、調整後營業利潤率、成本節省達成率、研發管線里程碑與新藥審批，以及股利覆蓋率與去槓桿進度。

需留意：營收年增資料缺失，去新冠化趨勢須其他季度佐證；重磅藥專利懸崖與管線兌現風險；本益比19.94反映轉型期不確定性

summary_en:
Pfizer beat EPS by a strong 16.18%, with cost savings and core drugs supporting earnings.
• EPS of $0.66 strongly beat the $0.57 estimate, a 16.18% positive surprise
• Revenue of $17.56B reflects a larger base period
• Cost-savings program effectiveness boosts earnings
• Oncology and core drug portfolio provide a stable revenue base

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a strong 16.18% EPS beat is driven mainly by cost savings and core-drug earnings, showing solid profit-defense execution amid COVID normalization. Near-term the beat supports sentiment, but the missing revenue YoY keeps the growth read conservative as the market watches whether full-year guidance is raised. Mid-term, oncology integration and pipeline delivery are key. Track: non-COVID revenue, adjusted operating margin, cost-savings attainment, R&D pipeline milestones and approvals, and dividend coverage plus deleveraging progress.

Watch：Missing revenue YoY means the COVID-normalization trend needs corroboration; Patent cliffs for key drugs and pipeline-delivery risk; A 19.94x P/E reflects transition-period uncertainty
